sn12.25:1.2: I 2 Atha kho āyasmā Bhūmijo sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn12.25:1.3: sammodaniyam kathām sārānīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bhūmijo āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca || || 3
sn12.25:2.1: Santāvuso Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkham paññāpenti ||
sn12.25:2.2: Santi panāvuso Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā param-
sn12.25:2.4: santi panāvuso Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkatañca paraṃ-katañca sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti || Santi panāvuso Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃ-kāram aparaṃ-kāram adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti || 4
sn12.25:2.5: Idha no āvuso Sāriputta Bhagavā kiṃvādi kimakkhāyī ||
sn12.25:2.6: kathaṃ vyākaramānā ca mayaṃ vuttavādino ceva Bhagavato assāma na ca Bhagavantam abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma || dhammassa cānudhammam vyākareyyāma na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgaccheyyāti || 5
sn12.25:3.1: Paṭicca-samuppannam kho āvuso sukhadukkhaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā ||
sn12.25:3.4: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva Bhagavato assa na ca Bhagavantam abhūtena abbhācikkheyya || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgaccheyya || || 6
sn12.25:4.1: Tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavāda sayaṃ-kataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti || tad api phassapaccayā || ||
sn12.25:4.4: Ye pi te samanabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃ-kāraṃ aparaṃkāram adhicca samuppannaṃ sukhadukkham paññāpenti || tad api phassapaccayā || || 7
sn12.25:5.1: Tatrāvuso ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netam ṭhānam vijjati ||
sn12.25:5.4: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃ-kāraṃ aparaṃ-kāram aḍhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkham paññāpenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netam ṭhanaṃ vijjatīti || || 8
sn12.25:6.1: Assosi kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmato Sāriputtassa āyasmatā Bhūmijena saddhim imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ || || 9
sn12.25:6.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || ||
sn12.25:6.3: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando yāvatako āyasmato Sāriputtassa āyasmatā Bhūmijena saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpo || tam sabbam Bhagavato ārocesi || || 10
sn12.25:7.1: Sādhu sādhu Ānanda || yathā taṃ Sāriputto sammāvyākaramāno vyākareyya ||
sn12.25:7.2: paṭicca-samuppannaṃ kho Ānanda sukhadukkhaṃ vuttam mayā ||
sn12.25:7.5: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva me assa na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam agaccheyya || 11
sn12.25:8.1: Tatrānanda ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃ-kataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti tad api phassapaccaye || ||
sn12.25:8.4: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃ-kāram aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamupannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti || tad api phassapaccayā || || 12
sn12.25:9.1: Tatrānanda ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃ-kataṃ sukhadukkham paññāpenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netaṃ ṭhanaṃ vijjati || ||
sn12.25:9.4: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃ-kāram aparaṃ-kāram adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti || te vata aññatra phassā pāṭisaṃvedissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || 13
sn12.25:10.1: Kāye vā hānanda sati kāyasañcetanā-hetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ ||
sn12.25:10.2: vācāya vā hānanda sati vacisañcetanā-hetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkham ||
sn12.25:10.3: mane vā hānanda sati manosañcetanā-hetu uppajjati ajjhattam sukhadukkhaṃ || || 14 Avijjāpaccayā va
sn12.25:11.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ Ānanda kāyasaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharoti yam paccayāssa tam uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ ||
sn12.25:11.2: pare vāssa taṃ Ānanda kāyasaṅkhāram abhīsaṅkharonti yam paccayāssa tam uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ || ||
sn12.25:11.3: Sampajāno vā tam Ānanda kāyasaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharoti yam paccāyassa tam uppajjati ajjhattam sukhadukkham ||
sn12.25:11.4: asampajāno vā tam Ānanda kāyasaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharoti yam paccayāssa tam uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkham || || 15
sn12.25:12.1: Sāmaṃ vātaṃ Ānanda vacīsaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharoti yam paccayāssa tam uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ ||
sn12.25:12.2: pare vāssa tam Ānanda vacīsaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharonti yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ || 16

sn12.25:13.1: Sāmaṃ vā tam Ānanda manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yam paccayāssa tam uppajjati ajjhattam sukhadukkhaṃ ||
sn12.25:13.2: Pare vāssa taṃ Ānanda manosaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharonti yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ || || 18
sn12.25:13.4: asampajāno vā tam Ānanda manosaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharoti yam paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattam sukhadukkhaṃ || || 19
sn12.25:14.1: Imesu Ānanda chasu dhammesu avijjā anupatitā ||
sn12.25:14.2: Avijjāya tveva Ānanda asesāvirāganirodhā so kāyo na hoti || yampaccayāssa tam uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ || Sa vācā na hoti yam paccayāssa tam uppajjati ajjhattam sukhadukkhaṃ || So mano na hoti yam paccayāssa tam uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ ||
sn12.25:14.3: khettaṃ taṃ na hoti || vatthu taṃ na hoti || āyatanaṃ taṃ na hoti || adhikaraṇaṃ taṃ na hoti || yam paccayāssa tam uppajjati ajjhattam sukhadukkhanti || ||
